## Exercise 1: Basic token counts

Use this sample text to compute token frequencies.

```{r}
text <- c("AI helps coding", "coding with AI")
words <- unlist(strsplit(tolower(text), "\\s+"))
sort(table(words), decreasing = TRUE)
```

## Exercise 2: Reproducible workflow

1. Create an R script that reads text input.
2. Compute simple descriptive statistics.
3. Save results to a CSV file.
